name: Stampli
description: Stampli is a cloud-based procure-to-pay (P2P) platform centered on accounts payable automation, with optional procurement, vendor management, payments, and expense/card management layered on top. Its Stampli AI codes, matches, and routes invoices, and the company states its platform processes 400,000+ invoices per week and has handled $400B+ in cumulative spend across 1,900+ customers.
best_for: Finance and AP teams — CFOs, controllers, and approvers — that want AP automation layered onto their existing ERP (QuickBooks, SAP, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, Sage, and others) rather than replacing it, with the option to add procurement, payments, and card spend management.
features: Stampli AI: automated invoice coding, matching, and routing
Accounts payable automation built around collaborative, invoice-centric communication between AP and approvers
Procurement controls before purchase commitment, available under "Stampli Beyond Accounts Payable"
Vendor management: self-service portal for vendors to submit information and check payment status
Payments that carry approval and accounting context through to execution
Expense and card spend management, including Stampli Cards and reimbursements
Deep Finance analytics, which Stampli describes as consultant-grade spend analysis
Native integrations with ERPs including QuickBooks, SAP, Oracle NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, and Sage platforms
pros: Built specifically to layer onto a company's existing ERP rather than replace it, with ERP integrations Stampli says it builds itself
Stampli reports 1,900+ customers and $400B+ in cumulative spend processed through the platform
cons: No published pricing — Stampli's pricing page routes to a "Request a Quote" form rather than any dollar figures or tiers
No free trial is advertised on Stampli's site

tiers.name: Accounts Payable
tiers.notes: Custom-quoted; no published price. Core AP automation: invoice coding, matching, routing, and approvals.

tiers.name: Beyond Accounts Payable
tiers.notes: Custom-quoted; no published price. Adds procurement, direct pay, credit cards, and advanced vendor management on top of the Accounts Payable tier.

alternatives.name: BILL
alternatives.description: A financial operations platform for small and midsize businesses combining a free corporate card with subscription-based accounts payable and receivable automation.
alternatives.best_for: Small and midsize businesses wanting a free corporate card alongside published, self-serve AP & AR pricing tiers.
strengths: Two-way sync with QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, and Sage Intacct

alternatives.name: Coupa
alternatives.description: An enterprise business spend management platform unifying procurement, sourcing, AP automation, expense, payments, and supply chain planning.
alternatives.best_for: Large enterprises wanting AP automation as part of a much broader spend-management suite rather than an AP-focused point solution.

alternatives.name: Tipalti
alternatives.description: A finance automation platform for accounts payable and global mass payments, built for high-volume international payouts.
alternatives.best_for: Mid-market and enterprise finance teams paying suppliers or partners across many countries and currencies.
strengths: Self-service payee portal with tax form collection
AI agents for invoice capture and PO matching
